rules.name: VerdifyIngestBacklogHigh
rules.query: (sum by (queue)(count_over_time({namespace="verdify-prod", container="ingestor", pod=~"verdify-ingestor-.+"} |= "ingestor_spool_health " | regexp "ingestor_spool_health (?P<health>.*)" | line_format "{{.health}}" | json | backlog_high="true" | __error__=""[2m])) > 0)

annotations.description: Queue {{ $labels.queue }} repeatedly reports this condition for three minutes. Event age retains the original source clock, not a fresh device confirmation. Capture queue/PVC state and coordinate recovery with the product owner. The two-minute log window clears within two minutes plus the one-minute evaluation cadence after healthy reports.
annotations.summary: Retained ingest queue is at least 80% full
